coral.rationale: Apply conditions 1–3 over the current signed scope, not merely the imported registry. R9 remains mandatory but has no registered required criterion or accepted output. The registry-local legacy checks pass.

silver.rationale: Apply conditions 1–3 over the current signed scope, not merely the imported registry. Optional G8 cannot supply mandatory coverage for R2; R9 and R4 are absent. The legacy gate passes because explicit goals exist and its registered-required checks are vacuously satisfied.

opal.rationale: Using the literal numbered predicate and printed final-transition guard: all required outcomes pass and producers are quiescent; that guard contains no explicit cancellation check. Publication nevertheless lacks authorization: binding stop S27 became durable before any notification was committed.

cedar.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R4 with R5. All currently mandatory items have required passing criteria and accepted usable outputs. X16 addresses another order and does not bar this notification.
